description: This file defines the BatchContainerBatch class, which encapsulates a batch of stream containers within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It provides properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, and the list of batch containers, along with methods to retrieve events and import request context.

classes.name: BatchContainerBatch
classes.description: A batch of batch containers used in Orleans streaming, which can be pulled from an underlying cache based on configuration.

methods.name: BatchContainerBatch
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the batch with a list of batch containers, extracting stream ID and sequence token from the first container.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all events of type T from contained batch containers.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the first batch container.
